# Protocol diagnostics and exit statuses

| Code | Class | Stable meaning | Retry guidance |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cli_usage` | `source` | The command, option, or argument grammar is invalid. | Correct the request using capabilities output. |
| `contract_registry_invalid` | `corrupt` | Executable contract descriptors violate uniqueness or completeness. | Use a verified executable build. |
| `contract_section` | `source` | A requested registry section is unknown or malformed. | Select one advertised section. |
| `contract_generated_output` | `infrastructure` | Generated contract output could not be published. | Correct the destination permissions or path. |
| `contract_generated_drift` | `source` | Checked-in generated contract bytes differ from executable truth. | Regenerate with the exact command reported by the diagnostic. |
| `predecessor_contract` | `source` | Input uses a predecessor contract rejected by direct cutover. | Recreate the request or authority under the advertised current contract. |

| Exit | Meaning |
|---:|---|
| 0 | successful or domain-classified nonfailure response |
| 2 | usage, source, semantic, precondition, or conflict failure |
| 3 | capability or cancellation failure |
| 4 | resource exhaustion |
| 5 | corrupt authority or derived state |
| 6 | host infrastructure failure |
| 7 | stale accepted base |
| 8 | invalid candidate meaning |
